Learn from zero

The beginner method, one short step at a time. Every turn plays on a 3D cube with an arrow, and picture cases show you which one matches your cube. Lost? “Where am I?” asks a few questions and finds your step.

Paint in its colors, or scan each side with your camera. You get the exact moves for your cube, with beginner moves or speed-method moves, and the app catches a sticker painted wrong.
